0.8.0.title: Modular runtime and custom bundles
0.8.0.summary: Splits the runtime into a core and 11 features, and adds a builder and analyzer for bundles that include only the features a site uses.

0.8.1.title: Pre-beta stabilization
0.8.1.summary: Fixes found by the internal experiments: safer CSS analysis with --root, keyboard focus timing, the :changed() lifecycle, and fast radio and checkbox choices with bind:. No new API.
highlights: The analyzer resolves root-relative stylesheets only against an explicit --root
Enter and typed keys no longer activate a newly focused button
:changed() waits only for animations its own rules start
Fast radio and checkbox choices with bind: always reach the state
0.8.1.limitations: Firefox and screen readers are not verified. WebKit engine issues (not library bugs, with state-driven workarounds in the docs): a text: value inside a section hidden by CSS can stay stale when the section is shown without a state change, and :has(:invalid) does not update when a required, empty <select> is enabled.

0.9.0.title: Declarative events and state
0.9.0.summary: A new authoring model: :on() event rules mutate a state on its own property, with event() data, bind() and persist() in state(), --attr-*, DOM text through content, focus requests, :blur and drag.
highlights: :on() event rules with the prevent() and stop() modifiers, plus keydown(Key), keyup(Key) and outside()
Mutations on the state's own property: set(), toggle(), increment(), decrement(), cycle()
event() with 32 fields, and event-time calc(), clamp(), mouse(), element() and random()
bind(value) and bind(checked) in state(); persist() for localStorage or sessionStorage (experimental)
--attr-* attributes and DOM text through content (experimental)
focus: when() focus requests (experimental) and the :blur selector
Drag gestures: :on(drag) and drag(start | move | end | cancel) (experimental)
Native-first random(), production diagnostic codes, and new custom-bundle features: gestures, persist, blur
0.9.0.breaking: Custom properties named --attr-<attribute> now write that attribute when the attribute is allowlisted (aria-* states, data-*, disabled, hidden, required, tabindex). Rename any --attr-* property used for another purpose. The rest of the 0.8 syntax keeps working; see the migration guide.
0.9.0.limitations: Minifiers that remove empty rules (esbuild minify, csso, Lightning CSS) delete modifier-only :on() rules such as a:on(click, prevent()) {}; minify Reactive stylesheets for whitespace only. Firefox, real Safari, touch and pen hardware and screen readers are not verified. persist(), content, focus: when(), drag and the --attr-* namespace are experimental. Bundle sizes are measured from the build on the Installation and Custom Bundles pages.
